actionable_steps.citation: Supreme Bliss Comes From Absolute Wisdom — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-09-01
actionable_steps.step: Stop eating when you feel you can still eat a little more — after eating, you should be able to get up as light as you sat down.

actionable_steps.citation: Supreme Bliss Comes From Absolute Wisdom — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-09-01
actionable_steps.step: Eat only fresh food — do not eat stale food prepared the previous day; keep it balanced, not oil-free, not excessive.

actionable_steps.citation: Obtain Divine Grace By Obeying Your Parents — SSS Vol 37 (2004), 2004-09-18
actionable_steps.step: Offer every meal to God with the Brahmarpanam prayer before you partake — He responds from within as the digestive fire.

actionable_steps.citation: Cultivate Satwic Qualities Right from Childhood — SSS Vol 38 (2005), 2005-10-22
actionable_steps.step: Partake of sathwic food (vegetables, greens, milk) and avoid rajasic and thamasic food, including excess chillies, salt, and sour items.

actionable_steps.citation: Listen To The Master Of The Universe — SSS Vol 35 (2002), 2002-11-23
actionable_steps.step: Let food be prepared with sacred feelings — the cook's unsacred thoughts enter the food and poison the mind.

actionable_steps.citation: The Head and The Heart — SSS Vol 25 (1992), 1992-03-15
actionable_steps.step: Feed your senses well too — 'see no evil, see what is good'; what the eyes and ears take in shapes the mind.

definition.citation: Acquire The Knowledge Of Brahman — SSS Vol 33 (2000), 2000-01-14
definition.quote: On this basis, the Vedas declared: 'Annam Brahma' (food is God). What is food? Does it constitute merely cereals and vegetables that we consume? No. The whole world is composed of food. Everything that exists in this world is food. Therefore, it is said, food is God.

discourses.citation: The Head and The Heart — SSS Vol 25 (1992), 1992-03-15
discourses.quote: Food, Head and God are the three whose unity will divinise man. Even Sathwik food (food which is conducive to the promotion of good qualities) should be consumed in moderation.

discourses.citation: Humility and Character are the Hallmark of Education — SSS Vol 38 (2005), 2005-03-16
discourses.quote: As the food, so is the mind. As the mind, so is the man. Hence, one must necessarily partake of sacred and sathwic (pure, serene) food to lead a happy and healthy life.

The company in which food is consumed, the place, the vessels in which it is cooked, the emotions that agitate the mind of the person who cooks it and serves it - all these have subtle influences on the nature and emotions of the person who takes the final product in!

discourses.citation: The Buddhi and the Atma — SSS Vol 23 (1990), 1990-05-26
discourses.quote: The state of the mind depends on the food that is consumed... The subtlest part goes to the mind. Hence the tendencies of the mind are based on the food that is eaten.

make_it_real: Food becomes the mind, and the mind becomes the man — so eat with gratitude, eat in moderation, and offer every meal to Him first.
title: Food

vahinis.quote: Food (anna) is not to be decried; that should be the vow of the wise... Food is the guru, for it leads you on to the knowledge of Brahman. Therefore, it should not be treated with disrespect. That must be observed just like a vow by the aspirant.

To make this body-machine function, the fuel of food (anna) has to be used. Food is not sacrifice, but it makes sacrifice possible. Therefore, eating food is not to be laughed at as catering to greed, as feeding of the stomach. It is part of worship.
